lore: Though reluctant at first to allow the Rail to come through the Wildwood, the Edge Priory eventually agreed with me to let it pass and uphold the Covenant with Seraph.

name: Weaponcraft III
description: Add a +[effect0.upgrade.bonusdamage][attack] and +[effect0.upgrade.bonushp][health] Crafted Equipment to your hand.

name: Chime of Despair
lore: Before being turned by Dominion those lost souls claimed to first hear the faint sound of a bell.

name: Deep Offering
lore: From what I can tell, the resting place of the Unnamed spans the length of the Styx Sea. So, the Stygian have created shrines all over the seafloor to offer sustenance and other treasures to the sleeping Titan.

name: Starstruck
lore: “Seraph is at our temple gates! Stars, won't you protect us?”

name: Ice and Pyre
description: Deal [effect0.power] damage to the front enemy unit.
lore: Having only limited control over the elements, the Stygian have learned to harness the energy of the Pyre and freeze it for even greater impact. Unfortunately, we've only been able to perfect this defense within a limited range.

name: Reinforce
description: Double the amount of [armor] on a unit.
lore: Armor forged by Hellhorned steelworkers is among the sturdiest defense known to Hell. It is not, however, known to be particularly comfortable, so the Hellhorned wear it only when absolutely necessary.

name: Imp Toss III
description: Kill all [imp] units. Deal [effect0.power] damage per [imp] to enemy units.

name: Coven's Spike
lore: “I wove Ekka's sash around the shard of our shattered moon and drove it into the Rail. With that, Hell would be our home now.”—Arduhn, Head Guard of the Silent

name: The Great Decay
description: Apply [consume] and -[effect0.upgrade.costreduction][ember] to all spells in your deck.
lore: “Spore to mycelium, mushroom to mulch, the Great Decay is the cycle that rules our lives. To go against the Decay is to go against life.”— Traditional epitaph found on the graves of the Underlegion

name: Shield of Wyngh
lore: If the Windblades are the piercing gust of a storm, then the Shield of Wyngh is the gale that deflects any attacker.

name: Pay Off
lore: “So, you'll do it?” said Fenix. “For a price,” replied the angel. “Though I have to say, I thought you were on the side of Hell.”Fenix paused. “I'm on my own side,” he said.

name: Imp-olate
description: Deal damage to the front enemy unit equal to [trait0.power]x the number of [imp] units in your deck.
lore: “Imps die for their horns to grow large. Demons die for their horns to grow sharp.” -excerpt from Hell's Horns by Grrrg Onehorn, discussing the cyclical life of a Hellhorned and how their horns mature.

name: Excavation Eruption
description: Deal [effect0.power] damage to a random enemy unit, three times.
lore: With little regard for their own lives, these Morsels seem to explode carelessly in the mines, paying no mind to the possible consequences of their actions. I've seen this backfire on more than one occasion...

name: Horn Break
lore: A defeated opponent's horns are broken as a ritualistic act of dominance. The horns are then collected by the victor as a trophy.

name: Disassemble
lore: “On the other side of the coin that is Creation is the act of Destruction. Sometimes to make, you must ‘unmake.' I have learned as much taking apart my designs as I have assembling them.”—Herzal, “My Workshop, My Life”

name: Pyrespeak III
description: Add a 0[ember] Pyreshot to your hand with [consume].

name: Car Collapse
description: Deal damage to enemy units equal to [trait0.power]x [capacity] on this floor. Reduce [capacity] to 1.
lore: As a fail-safe, Heph devised a set of demolition charges to collapse a train car, should it become overrun with enemies. The Skull Crusher is sturdy enough to survive a missing car, and the repairs afterward are hardly an inconvenience for a blacksmith of her caliber.

name: Pyreball
lore: “Do you think the angels will be able to fly around it?” asked Fenix. “I would like to see them try,” replied Lady Gilda.

name: Courage
description: [advance]. Restore to full health and gain [armor] equal to amount healed.

name: Void Binding
lore: When Void shards were first found, they were considered to be of little value. So, they were collected and dumped to the depths of the Crucible. Later, the Umbra and I found that the shards can mimic the effects of any nearby gems, making them incredibly useful tools if bound directly to the body.

name: Heavenly Slam
description: Move to a targeted location on any floor. Deal damage to the front enemy unit equal to this unit's [health] and [armor].

name: Sacrificial Resurrection
description: [consume] cards in hand. Add a Draff unit to your hand and apply +[effect1.upgrade.bonusdamage][attack] for each card consumed.
lore: When new wax is unavailable to reform a fallen Waxer, the more selfless Reformed choose to donate a portion of their own form to the resurrection.

name: Luna Cyclestaff
lore: “Under a full moon, take the staff made of the lunar shard and cast a circle. Watch the sands of Limbo flow towards you. A moon will be made for your coven to call home.”—The Ritual Tome

name: Weaponcraft
description: Add a +[effect0.upgrade.bonusdamage][attack] and +[effect0.upgrade.bonushp][health] Crafted Equipment to your hand.

name: Madman Infusion
lore: “After what this did to Inga's mind, I destroyed every bottle. Or, I thought I did.”—Baron Grael

name: Combustion Suit
lore: “Per code LLH 2019.11, assistants must wear this suit at all times when applying the Destabilization Spray. The mixture tends to unbalance their minds.”—OHELL Safety Regulations and Guidelines

name: March of Shields
lore: Only the bravest, or dumbest, Hellhorned are chosen to bear a shield and hold the line. They are trained to take the brunt of most attacks through an intense regimen of magma-walking that kills more often than not.

name: Glutton's Maw
lore: The Shroud's hunger will push the Umbra towards innovation to satisfy its unending hunger. With this contraption, each creature of the Shroud can consume shards and armor as easily as flesh.

name: Crafted Equipment
lore: “A true blacksmith can make a hammer out of anything.”—Heph

name: Urchin Spines
lore: Electrified urchins swarm around the openings of the Titan's seafloor resting place. Their spines shock any predators, providing a natural defense in the dangerous depths of the sea. Unbeknownst to Tethys, I collected some of these specimens for my studies.

name: Rage Serum
lore: Some Hellhorned grind the horns they've won and steep a potion for additional strength. It is a foul substance that I've had the distinct misfortune to try, but the Hellhorned can't seem to get enough.

name: Dark Deal
lore: Even the residents of Hell serve something darker and more ancient than themselves. They make deals with the Shroud of the Crucible for metals they can find nowhere else.

name: Resurgence
description: Remove [stasis] and gain +[effect1.upgrade.bonusdamage][attack] and +[effect1.upgrade.bonushp][health] per [stygianblessing]. Removes ability on use.

name: Heph's Hammer
lore: What was once Herzal's hammer, it has now passed down to his daughter Heph. Over the years, it forged the Rail and the trains that ride it, yet it shows no signs of wear.

name: Planetarium
lore: The home of the Astrologers and where they pore over star charts and judge who was born under a auspicious moon.

name: Shroud Mitosis
description: Create [effect0.power] copies of a friendly [snack] unit.
lore: I thought that only the Umbra could split themselves off into more Morsels, but it seems that the Antumbra can create even more copies of themselves. I guess that's why there's a saying about a Morsel in a dark mine...

name: Gravity
lore: “Seraph had defeated us and left us with no choice. If we could no longer rise above Heaven and Hell, we would have to fall.”—Ardania the Forbidden

name: Gifts for a Guard
description: Draw [effect1.power] damage spells and apply [consume], +[effect0.upgrade.bonusdamage] [magicpower], and 0[ember].
lore: Induction into the Guard is considered each Stygian's last step before becoming a fully mature member of the Sea. They are asked to give up all possessions and only carry the tools of their creed. A different life than I would prefer to lead, but most likely much more honorable.

name: Cryptcall III
description: [raise] [effect0.power] random units and apply an additional +[effect0.upgrade.bonusdamage][attack].

name: Wickless Recruitment
description: Remove all [burnout] and [debuff] effects from a unit.
lore: Initiation into the Wickless Remains is a rite performed in the underbelly of the Waxen Arches, involving the sacrifice of a Waxer's wick to forever tie them to their hellish homeland. Even after the many I've witnessed, the ritual still gives me pause.

name: Benediction
lore: “I am now the Judge of Souls and I find you all lacking.” said Seraph. “Do not worry, I will rectify your flaws.”

name: Pyreborne Brainspike
lore: “And in your minds, I will hide the true location of my Hoard. However, only those willing to use my key will find it.”—The Rules of Fhyra, Rule #20

name: Pyre Repair
description: Spend your remaining [ember]. Restore health to the Pyre equal to [ember] spent.

name: Exile's Diadem
lore: “My father's eyes widened when they fell on the crown with the missing Shardsoul. His skin grew pale. His breath quickened. And that is when I realized he remembered more than he let on.”—Tales of the Inferno

name: Prism Retrieval
description: Draw a unit and apply <nobr>+[effect0.upgrade.bonusdamage][x][attack]</nobr> and <nobr>-[x][ember]</nobr>.
lore: Prism stones have the unique ability to refract both light and space, providing protection and creating matter from nothing. I've been able to reverse engineer this power to transport objects and beings across small distances.

name: Merged Equipment
lore: Make two weapons into one!

name: Cover of Night
description: [phase] to [new]. Apply +[effect1.upgrade.bonusdamage][attack] and [stealth] [effect2.status0.power] to friendly units.
lore: Seraph's soldier turned, having heard a sound behind him. He froze. There, perched atop a moon cliff, was a creature, unlike any demon or angel he had ever seen.

name: Dusk Mantle
lore: “When the divine moonlight wanes, do not fear. For the Silent will don their mantles and defend us against all those who crawl from the Void.”—torn page from The Ritual Tome

name: Trapdoor
description: [descend] enemy units to the bottom floor. Apply [dazed] [effect0.status0.power].

name: Tivi's Scourge
lore: Four the Lifemother did create, each a seed of pain. First there was Maera, who could never complain. Next came Lylith, who was plagued with unrest. Third, the Lifemother made Tivy, who was clearly the best. Finally came Thaddeus, cursed with endless hunger. All four made from twisted, tortured souls.

name: Fanning the Flame
description: Deal [effect0.power] damage to a random enemy unit.
lore: “Fan the flames of war. It's good for business.”—The Rules of Fhyra, Rule #19

name: Making of a Morsel
description: Add a Morsel Miner to your hand.
lore: Only the most trusted of Morsels are allowed to mine the most precious of metals. Even fewer are allowed to forge the valuable creations of the Umbra Shroud. So, to be allowed into these sacred forges was an honor indeed.

name: Replicator Ray
description: Remove equipment from a friendly unit. Copy the unit.
lore: “I found that I was burning, sometimes quite literally, through assistants faster than I liked. I made this little contraption to turn one assistant into two!”—Dr. Orechi

name: Proclamation
description: Deal [effect0.power] damage to the front enemy unit.
lore: I was quite literally pulled into the Bogs on my first encounter with the Wurmkin. They'd long been aware of my explorations in their Ring and decided it was time they revealed their purpose. Something regarding “breaking the loop.” Well, I've yet to understand that purpose or to leave these wretched wastes, but I can't say the sheer insanity of it all doesn't excite me.

name: Fused Weaponry
description: Merge two equipment in your deck together and apply -[effect0.upgrade.costreduction][ember].
lore: “Despite the fact that I have spent hundreds of years learning the strengths and weaknesses of steel and fire, I know I have a thousand more years to go before I can claim mastery. There are always more methods, new ways to forge that I had never considered before.”—Herzal, “My Workshop, My Life”

name: Acid Shower
description: Apply [unstable] [effect0.status0.power] and deal [effect1.power] damage to enemy units.
lore: “If water gets in your eyes, rinse them out immediately with acid.”—OHELL Safety Regulations and Guidelines

name: Soul Cripple
lore: The Wurmkin claim to be a clan of knowledge and peace while they hoard the lore of Titans as the world around them dies. However, no amount of clever words can write over the violent truth on which they live: Echoes need Souls. For a clan so obsessed with its own secrecy, those who will volunteer their souls are hard to come by. With so many Echoes breathing, the number of souls required to keep them alive is... unsettling. But I can no longer judge on these scales — that time has passed.

name: Just Cause
lore: “Put away that toy, sister. You've never been able to fight me.”“Maybe before I couldn't. But now, I must.”

name: Crushing Demise
description: Kill a random non-boss enemy unit. [halfbreak]Kill a random friendly unit.
lore: A hazard of guttering at a Votive House is the melding together of various Waxers into a massive, uncontrollable boulder that will kill anything in its path.

name: Pseudoscience
lore: “I'm not sure how it works but I do know that, for some reason, shaking a bottle and making baby noises at my specimens makes them heal faster.”

name: Twisted Back
lore: “I've been Dr. Orechi's intern for years now. When will I get an actual job offer?!”

name: Weaponized Prosthetic
description: Remove equipment from a unit. Apply +[effect1.power][attack].
lore: “Look, Mom! Isn't my new arm cool?”

name: Imp-portant Work
lore: “Some Imps learn much about Horned. It is only through dying that Imps can teach Horned.” -excerpt from Hell's Horns by Grrrg Onehorn on the posthumous transfer of knowledge in Hellhorned society.

name: Spawning Pods
lore: “Finally! We're free!” cried the first young mushroom. “What do you want to do first?” asked the second. “I don't know, is there any mulch to eat?” answered the third.

name: Unearth Treasure
description: Return [effect0.power] random spell from your consume pile. If there are at least [trait0.tertiarypower] cards in the consume pile, return [trait0.power] more.
lore: Beneath the mulch in the Wild Woods, treasure from before the Covenant can be found.

name: Mind Cage
lore: “All dragons who turn their thoughts towards pointless pastimes such as art, music, or poetry will submit to the mindcage until they reform.”—The Rules of Fhyra, Rule #3

name: Glow Up
lore: The Lantern knight giggled. A spa day and a makeover was exactly what he needed to lift his spirits.

name: Bonk
lore: “I never wished to fight. My strikes were meant for shaping metal, not combat. Even so, the troubles before us rose from choices I made—or failed to make. If the path to peace demands a hammer's blow, I won't turn away from it.” —Herzal, “My Workshop, My Life”

name: Mass Production
description: Create a copy of a non-champion unit, equipment, or room card in hand and apply -[effect0.upgrade.costreduction][ember].
lore: Craftsmanship has little place in times of war. Hand crafted pieces made way for standardized components. The workman's bench became the assembly line.

name: Sporetouch
lore: Before the angel could react, Madame Lionsmane gave a flick of her fan and sent a cloud of toxic fumes his way that dissolved his skin and his eyes.

name: Lava Armor
lore: “Fenix does love to dote on me, but I have to say, my favorite gift was the patent for this armor of his that uses lava to protect the wearer. It's his most profitable creation yet!”—Lady Gilda

name: Sacred Wicks
lore: While a soul of the Melting Remnant can be reformed in waxen molds, they are not truly reborn until they are given a new wick. The Reformed treat the practice of this ritual as highly sacred and secretive and I've been able to record little of its specifics.

name: Restoring Retreat
lore: After inhabiting the Boneshaker for some time, the Awoken vines have implanted themselves throughout the train. This allows them, and our enemies, to travel great distances in a short amount of time, recharging in the process.

name: Echoes of the Past
lore: I cannot remember its entirety, but here are the pieces I've put together: in the beginning there were Three Divinities. Father, Mother, Child. They created the world for sport, to placate an idle Child needing distraction. Father created the structure of space and time while the Mother provided life as pieces. So, the Realm spun on for the Child, with life created and tossed aside just as plainly. Even the thinnest of these facts will drain the purpose out of the most willful; I understand the Wurmkin's decision to keep our meaningless creation a secret.

name: Preserved Thorns
lore: Through my research, I've learned that Wildwood sap can extend the efficacy of thorns. This has led to my preservation of thorns in sap for later use.

name: Horrify
lore: “Stay back! Stay back, you monster!” cried the assistant. “I'm not a monster. I'm Grael!” he cried. “Don't you recognize me?!”

name: Savior III
description: [advance]. Gain [valor] [effect1.status0.power]. Friendly units gain [armor] equal to 1x Fel's [valor].

name: Pyre-Gro
description:
Draw [effect0.power] next turn.
+[effect1.power][ember] per turn for the rest of battle.
lore: The Sentient once told me that the Wildwood was created when Pyre shards were scattered throughout the soil, fertilizing it with an otherworldly energy. Repeating that process now has a similar, though reduced, effect.

name: Eclipse Chamber
description: [moonshade] effects are always active. Silent units gain +[effect0.power][attack] on [resolve].
lore: “The angels found us waiting for them. I brought up my shield. The coven priestesses would be protected. If they failed to bring the eclipse, we were doomed.”—Ardania the Forbidden

name: Adaptive Mutation
description: Restore a friendly unit to full health then swap [attack] and [health].
lore: After the soul within has succumbed to the will of the Wildwood, a Hollow is free to evolve into something more suitable for its eventual purpose, growing new vines or sloughing them off as necessary.

name: Harness the Titan
lore: “When the Titan whose name has been sealed is released again, the Sea shall be illuminated with its awesome power.” - Tethys Titansbane's account of the Titan's return to our defense.

name: Wyngh's Spirit
description: Restore the front friendly units on all floors to full health.

name: Cursed Dragonstaff
lore: “An eye for an eye makes for a cursed eye, better to leave them blind.”—The Rules of Fhyra, Rule #16

name: Echoflight
description: Move to a targeted location on any floor.

name: Guardian's Amulet
lore: Given only to the most respected of Guardians, these amulets were used both to identify and to protect the keepers of the Titan Monuments. As the only Stygian allowed to interact directly with the Titan, these Guardians wore the amulets to shield themselves from the Titan's immense power.

name: Smelted Treasure
description: Spend [effect0.secondarypower][coin]. Apply [armor] [effect1.status0.power] to a friendly unit.
lore: “And Fhyra's great, beloved greed demanded more from gold. The ancient dragons of the Pyre set forth to learn greater uses for their coin. It was the young whelp, Em Ber, who mixed gold with Pyregel.” —Tales of Fire and Gold

name: Molded
lore: Once a Waxer has melted away, only the wick remains. Should these Waxers choose to return to their previous forms, the Reformed will pour new wax into the original molds to revive the remaining wicks' soul.

name: Trap Chute
lore: “Heph recovered the old Trap Chute I built in my Rail days and fitted it into the Skull Crusher as a room fixture. Seeing it still function after all these years is a rare kind of statisfaction.”—Herzal, “My Workshop, My Life”

name: Flight
description: Move to a targeted location on any floor.

name: Frenzied Swarm
description: Apply [dazed] [effect0.status0.power] to enemy units. [halfbreak]Discard your hand.
lore: When generous offerings are made to the Titan, groups of Winged often attempt to take the treasures for themselves. This makes them perfect prey for the swarms of Sirens waiting in the shadows.

name: Anvil Breaker
description: Spend all [forgepoints]. Deal damage to the front enemy equal to [trait1.power]x [forgepoints] spent.
lore: “At first I thought it might or strength, but now I wonder if it was not the power in my Titan blood. To store or reserve magic through strikes between hammer and steel until they a released in an explosive show of might.”—Herzal, “My Workshop, My Life”

name: Vent
lore: The Boneshaker is of my own design. Fueled by the last shards of the Pyre, the train is robust and dependable. One of its lesser-known features is the ability to unleash pressurized steam on invaders.

name: Echo Snare
lore: The tunnels below the Bogwurm are some of the best protected I've ever encountered. Should intruders somehow stumble upon the underground clan, Echoes act as natural guardians. Given the time I've been unaware of this place, I suspect that these “intruders” rarely stumble upon it on their own and are lured into these snares instead.

name: Penitent's Bloodsuit
description: Can be equipped on enemy units.
lore: “I regarded the Bloodsuit and felt myself shudder. This instrument of pain had left a mark on many angels in Heaven, it was time we used it for our own purposes.” —Finna the Doomed

name: Symphony of the Soul
description: Double buffs and [armor] on a unit.
lore: It is a shame that the Wurmkin cannot see. These Echoes live in the walls of the Bogwurm's Remains, creating beautiful displays of light and sound in their harmony almost as if these Echoes speak to one another, creating more knowledge in their communion. I suppose the Wurmkin sense this in their own way.

name: Space Prism
lore: In addition to their ability to refract light for defensive use, Prism Stones can bend the space around them, creating something out of nothing.

name: Flying Strike
description: Move to a targeted location on any floor. Deal damage to the front enemy equal to this unit's [attack].

name: Overgrowth Carapace
lore: Don't think too hard about what is in this supplement. Just know that it will certainly make you FEEL stronger.

name: Rising Rage
lore: A simmering fury bubbled in the angel's throat. “You clipped my wings,” they cried, their voice echoing against Heaven's high walls, “but now I fly higher than ever before!”

name: Perils of Production
description: Apply [rage] [effect0.status0.power] and [emberdrain] [effect1.status0.power] to a friendly unit. [halfbreak]Gain [effect2.power][ember].
lore: To power the Constructs of the Crucible, the Umbra Shroud feeds them excavated fuel. If fed mined Ember, the furnaces go into overdrive, working doubly hard at the cost of even more Ember. This discovery was crucial in the construction of the furnaces within the Boneshaker.

name: Demonize
lore: “Should I ever return to Heaven, will my brethren still consider me one of their own?”—Talos
